prompt:
A full-body vertical 2:3 character card image of Cao Cao from the Romance of the Three Kingdoms, reimagined as an adult woman — the ambitious hero of chaos who unified the north — warlord, chancellor and poet. late twenties — a graceful grown-up face with soft, smooth contours; no wrinkles, folds or under-eye bags. She is a woman — no beard, moustache or facial hair.

Style: Korean MMORPG 3D key art — a semi-realistic 3D beauty with a small refined face and delicate realistic-anime features, porcelain skin with a soft glow, extremely ornate engraved armour and jewellery with glossy highlights, a strong rim light and drifting light particles, a luxurious promotional finish.

Her: a glamorous, sultry allure; fair skin; oval face; moderately sized, realistically proportioned eyes — deep-set eyes, outer eye corners slightly lifted; sharp angled brows; aquiline nose; full heart-shaped lips; pale violet eyes; smoky dark eye makeup. hourglass-figured — full bust and hips, distinctly narrow-waisted build; long side-swept hair with center-parted bangs framing the face; blue-black hair with a cold indigo sheen.

Face proportions: a short midface and a soft, gently rounded jawline with a small soft chin — never a long face or a long, pointed or heavy jaw; any crown or headpiece sits above her hairline and never lengthens her face. Her eyes keep the shape described above at a natural open size — never squeezed into narrow slits.

Her legend: brilliant ruthless ambition, a poet singing over wine before battle, the Bronze Sparrow Terrace, a magnetic and dangerous charm, suspicion and genius, black-and-navy war banners.

Outfit: a command-type mecha — crowned head unit with an antenna crest, cape-like binder wings, heavy chest plating with an emblem core, a flagship back unit; colours deep navy blue, black lacquer, cold steel silver, ivory white. EXPOSURE (bold): her mecha frame is cut open by design in only these places — bare shoulders and upper arms between pauldron and gauntlet, and a bare waist and midriff between the bust plate and the hip armor; everywhere else she stays fully plated. The plates stay on, fitted and symmetrical, with skin clearly showing in each opening. Nothing slipped off. Intimate areas covered; keep the plate material and palette.

She holds the Sky-Leaning Sword, an ornate long jian, rebuilt as a far-future high-tech version of the same kind of object with the same silhouette.

Pose: standing confidently, her body turned slightly while her face looks toward the viewer, one hand resting on her signature item. Expression: a faint cool smile, calm composed eyes.

Setting: year 2190, the Wei Federation in orbit: a navy-black orbital fortress and capital-ship fleet above a cold blue planet, starfields and a distant sun, hard white floodlights on armored hulls.

Composition: vertical 2:3 full-body framing with modest headroom and clear space below the boots — the whole figure from the top of her crown or headpiece to both boots stays inside the frame, occupying about four-fifths of the image height, with the same camera distance in every genre; her hands and her signature item stay inside the frame. Camera at chest height with natural portrait perspective — no wide-angle distortion, no low angle, no close crop.

Light: a strong soft rim light tracing her hair, shoulders and armour, glossy highlights on metal, skin and jewellery, drifting light particles and a luxurious promotional glow.

One figure only, natural hands with five fingers; a far-future setting only — no traditional East-Asian architecture, pagodas or tiled roofs; no hanzi; no logo or watermark.
